fields.from: Dr. Paulo Reyes, Medical Director, Calloway Cruise Line
fields.to: CDC Miami Quarantine Station; Port Canaveral port health liaison
fields.summary: As of 06:00 on Nov 6 the cumulative reportable cases for the voyage are 61 of 2,410 passengers (2.5 percent) and 14 of 980 crew (1.4 percent). The 24-hour report and the 2 percent special report have been sent to the Vessel Sanitation Program.
responseInProgress: Ill passengers isolated in cabins until 24 hours after symptoms end
Ill food employees off duty for 48 hours after symptoms end
Outbreak prevention and response plan cleaning running
Specimens collected and held for shipment on VSP direction
requests: Confirm the time of the Vessel Sanitation Program boarding
Advise on cleaning of Cruise Terminal 3 before embarkation opens at 11:00
Identify a contact at the port authority for the turnaround
fields.contact: Ship medical center, bridge line 7-1204; Shoreside operations center, (555) 010-4400
